title: Worker 64-byte record range construction
summary: Recovers the forward 64-byte range construction at 0x520b60. Each record copies its first 16 bytes, then initializes and copies the 48-byte tail using the original constructor's ordered operations. The range endpoint is compared for equality and a null destination skips the current record before advancing.
test_description: Direct original comparison over empty through three-record ranges, varied source and destination offsets including both overlap directions and unaligned addresses, checking return values and the entire guarded buffer. Also checks empty and single-record null destinations.
known_limits: Record field meanings and original source-level signature are unknown.
Nonempty ranges must reach the end by 64-byte increments; inaccessible addresses and multi-record null destinations are outside normal-path tests.
The portable adapter does not reproduce the original register calling convention.
